heading: Meet Phil
text: Phil Ehr’s first mission in the Navy was the Mariel Boatlift, where he helped rescue Cuban exiles who risked it all for freedom and opportunity in America. He went on to serve a full career in the Navy and beyond—often in harm’s way— fighting communists, fascists and terrorists. Phil’s lifelong commitment to our freedoms, democracy and prosperity continues in his campaign to replace Rep. Carlos Gimenez in Congress. Florida’s 28th Congressional District includes Southwest Miami-Dade County (West Kendall, The Hammocks, West Richmond Heights, Goulds, South Dade, Homestead, Florida City) and the beautiful Florida Keys.

heading: I am proud to endorse retired Navy Commander Phil Ehr for Congress. Phil Ehr has a proven track record of fighting for freedom abroad and he will fight for freedom here at home. With the House of Representatives being pushed to extremism we need candidates like Phil Ehr who will always put people before political partisanship.
ROOTED IN SERVICE
text: Leaders like Phil Ehr exemplify unwavering integrity, relentless problem-solving, and the ability to forge new paths. Phil’s distinguished record in the Navy and beyond is a testament to these qualities.

heading: ROOTED IN SERVICE
text: The dire need for change in South Florida is clear. Our community is plagued by corruption, while Tallahassee is preoccupied with divisive culture wars, and Washington is compromised by anti-democratic extremists. Tragically, Carlos Gimenez is complicit in these grave threats.

heading: ROOTED IN SERVICE
text: We can trust Phil Ehr to continue serving with integrity. He will find solutions that matter to everyday people in South Florida, and he’ll fight for our freedom, democracy, and prosperity.

heading: Distinguished Naval Service
text: Phil Ehr advanced from Navy Seaman to Commander in a 26-year active duty career. He flew reconnaissance in the Cold War, combat support in Desert Storm, and oversaw U.S. combat operations in Allied Force, which was the most intense and sustained combat operation in Europe between World War II and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. On shore duty, Phil provided strategic advice to senior leaders in Washington, Silicon Valley, London, and NATO, including the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, General Colin Powell; and helped civilian agencies use declassified space technology to improve border security, federal firefighting, and earth science research.

heading: Distinguished Naval Service
text: Phil’s first mission in the Navy was the Mariel Boatlift in the Florida Strait rescuing men, women and children who risked their lives escaping brutality in Cuba for freedom and opportunity in America.

heading: Beyond the Navy
text: After the Navy, Phil taught children the game of chess in schools and fought Russian corruption in the World Chess Federation. Phil also taught British officers in their war college, challenged craven politicians who manipulated Americans with bigotry and lies, and founded a nonprofit to counter disinformation in domestic politics with combat-proven military tactics. Phil recently completed dozens of humanitarian aid delivery missions in Ukraine for people who—like the Cuban exiles he saw four decades earlier—risked it all for freedom.

heading: Beyond the Navy
text: Phil and Sue, his wife of 28 years, are blessed with two daughters. Phil is running to represent the people of South Miami-Dade and the Florida Keys, because they are suffering from extremism and chaos in Congress. New leadership is needed to solve problems that matter and to defend American freedoms, democracy and prosperity.
